domestic_evidence: No public domestic-supply record retrieved. GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender awards and annual-report India revenue splits were not accessible: web_search returned a backend error ("searx: <urlopen error [Errno 111] Connection refused>") on both attempts, and thecompanycheck.com returned HTTP 403. Registered address visible in the customs record: "903 CORPORATE AVENUE SONAWALA ROAD NEXT TO UDYOG BHAVAN GOREGAON EAST" (Mumbai, Maharashtra) — address only, not supply evidence. Domestic turnover: null (not public in retrieved sources).
note: Export activity is factually confirmed by dated Indian customs/bill-of-lading records, not by website claims: 5 distinct shipments 2025-07-19 to 2026-01-21, destinations Nigeria, Bonaire (Netherlands Antilles), Oman (x2), Tanzania, with B/L numbers 8926206, 8129512, 2154532, 0303477, 3698154. IMPORTANT HS DISCREPANCY: declared HS 731100 (containers for compressed/liquefied gas, iron/steel) does NOT match any of the five observed shipment HS codes — 84139190 (pump parts), 84814000 (valves/taps), 84162000 (gas burners, x2), 40169320 (rubber O-rings). Per project rule 3 this is NOT grounds for rejection: company stays in the base, actual HS codes recorded as observed (84162000 gas burners appears most frequently and is closest to the declared gas-equipment profile), verdict accepted_hs_corrected with this caveat. Note the direction ambiguity: ImportKey labels these as India customs records with the company shown in the supplier column and Indian ports (NHAVA SHEVA SEA INNSA1, BOMBAY AIR CARGO, SAHAR AIR CARGO) as origin, i.e. exports from India to the listed destinations — consistent with an exporter role, though the page header also says "Import Customs Data", so the free view does not fully disambiguate import vs export direction; the origin/destination columns do. Role appears to be manufacturer_trader (mixed own-product burners plus third-party spares such as Blackmer pumps and brass valves). Slug variants tried: globe-gas-equipments-industry-private-limited (populated, 145 records), globe-gas-equipments-industry-pvt-ltd (empty shell, 0 rows), globe-gas-equipments-industry (empty shell, 0 rows) — only the full "private limited" slug carries data. Second sources volza.com and eximpedia.app both returned HTTP 403, so no independent cross-check of the 145 figure was possible. Domestic supply: no traces found in accessible sources — stated as unknown rather than assumed, since the search backend was down rather than the evidence being absent. Revenue/export volume figures: null, not public in retrieved sources.
